query:
DELETE FROM realtime_outbox
            WHERE (
                    $1 > 0
                AND status = $2
                AND dispatched_at IS NOT NULL
                AND dispatched_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => $1)
            )
            OR (
                    $3 > 0
                AND status = $4
                AND created_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => $3)
            )
